definition: Identification of a document as well as the document number and type of link.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identifier of the document (message) assigned either by the account servicer or the account owner.

DocumentNumber.name: Document Number
DocumentNumber.definition: Identification of the type of document.

LinkageType.name: Linkage Type
